name: io.github.hexsleeves/tailscale-mcp-server
description: MCP server for operating Tailscale from any MCP client. Provides tools for device management, network operations, ACL/DNS/key administration, and exit node control. Supports stdio and HTTP transports with risk-gated access levels.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Tailscale OAuth client ID (preferred authentication method). Must be provided together with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Tailscale OAuth client secret. Required when TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is set.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Tailscale legacy API key (fallback when OAuth credentials are not provided). Obtain from https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_TAILNET
environment_variables.description: Tailnet name or '-' to use the default tailnet for the authenticated user.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_ALLOWED_TOOL_RISK
environment_variables.description: Maximum risk level for tool execution. 'read' (default) allows only non-mutating operations. 'write' enables ACL, DNS, route, and tag mutations. 'admin' additionally enables destructive operations such as device deletion, connect/disconnect, and auth key management.

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_CLI_PATH
environment_variables.description: Path to the local Tailscale CLI binary. Required for CLI-backed tools (get_network_status, connect_network, disconnect_network, ping_peer, get_version).

environment_variables.name: TAILSCALE_API_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Tailscale REST API base URL. Override only for testing against a mock server; must use https except for localhost.

environment_variables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: Transport mode. 'stdio' (default) for local MCP clients. 'http' for network deployments; requires MCP_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN.

environment_variables.name: MCP_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Bearer token for HTTP transport authentication. Must be at least 32 characters. Required when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environment_variables.name: MCP_HTTP_BIND_HOST
environment_variables.description: Host to bind the HTTP server to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 (loopback only).

environment_variables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional Host header values allowed in HTTP mode.

environment_variables.name: MCP_SERVER_LOG_FILE
environment_variables.description: Optional file path for log output. When unset, logs go to stderr.
